description: Answers 'what does this course page say?' Reads the Page activities of one course, the pages listed as page in get_course_content, and returns their text with the HTML removed. Up to 5 pages are shown, each up to 20000 characters, and a longer page ends with [truncated]. Images and embedded media are not shown. Input: course_id, the ID from get_my_courses, and page_name, an optional word or phrase from the page title to pick one page; leave it out to read the first pages of the course. Ask: 'Read the Week 2 reading page in Networking Basics.'

course_id.description: Moodle course ID. Use get_my_courses to find it.

page_name.description: Part of the page title, as shown in get_course_content. Leave out to read the first pages.

name: get_course_page
title: Course page
